verdicts.reason: A keeps the reading order (eyebrow, big headline, body, CTA) with a clear hierarchy and the confetti/book panel at left, but the logo is shrunk to an illegible speck in the card's top-left corner and the legal text is crammed beside the CTA. B puts the eyebrow below the body copy, sizes the body almost as large as the headline, and pushes a tiny, unreadable logo into the bottom-left corner beside a cramped legal line, which weakens hierarchy and brand presence.
